MA.O.A1.standard: W1 relative to a stated metatheory

PH.O.A1.standard: prediction matches measurement within stated uncertainty; derivation valid
PH.O.A1.defeaters: regime exceeded (speed near c, action near ħ)

PH.O.A2.standard: controlled experiment with quoted uncertainty; replication; 5σ for discovery claims in particle physics

PH.O.A3.standard: observation with stated uncertainty; independent probes agree
PH.O.A3.defeaters: model dependence, selection effects, cosmic variance

PH.O.A3.5.standard: internal consistency; no empirical warrant yet

PH.O.A4.standard: measured property matches a derived value

PH.O.A5.standard: measurement, or simulation with an error bound

CH.O.A1.standard: elemental analysis within stated error; IUPAC rule followed

CH.O.A2.standard: diffraction or spectroscopic structure; computation with stated basis set and error

CH.O.A3.standard: measured K or ΔH agrees with derivation

BI.O.A1.standard: Replicated cross or edit; sequencing with stated error rate; independent lab confirmation
BI.O.A1.defeaters: Contamination; off-target edits; annotation error; linkage mistaken for causation

BI.O.A1.2.warrant: W3, W4, W12 (code tables, gene nomenclature)

BI.O.A2.5.standard: Isolation and sequencing; replication in host cells

BI.O.A3.standard: Controlled physiology or developmental perturbation; dose–response

BI.O.A3.5.warrant: W3, W4, W12 (husbandry and diagnostic standards)
BI.O.A3.5.standard: Replicated field or herd trial with stated season, population and measure

BI.O.A4.standard: Phylogeny with support values; congruent independent data
BI.O.A4.defeaters: Long-branch attraction; incomplete lineage sorting; horizontal transfer

BI.O.A4.1.warrant: W1 (derivations from stated assumptions), W4, W2
BI.O.A4.1.standard: Derivation with stated hypotheses; model fit with stated assumptions

BI.O.A4.2.standard: Variance-component estimate with stated design and population

BI.O.A5.standard: Replicated field or mesocosm experiment; time series with stated uncertainty

EA.O.A1.1.defeaters: Solid solution misread as new species

EA.O.A3.standard: Stratigraphic context; correlation by two independent methods

EA.O.A3.3.standard: Stated decay constant, closure assumption and uncertainty

EA.O.A4.standard: Field or remote measurement with accuracy assessment; process model calibrated and validated

EA.O.A4.3.standard: Homogenised records with uncertainty; model ensembles with stated spread; detection and attribution

EA.O.A5.2.standard: Place meaning traced to interview and text

MD.O.A2.standard: causal identification (Mendelian randomisation, natural experiments); mechanism shown

MD.O.A4.defeaters: surrogate endpoints, publication bias, short follow-up

ST.O.A3.1.standard: As A3, with the threat and the demand both documented.

ST.O.A4.standard: The pattern holds across campaigns of differing type and era.

ST.O.A4.1.standard: Argument from definitions, traced to classical texts read in context.

ST.O.A4.2.standard: The claim holds across campaigns of differing type and era.

ST.O.A5.1.standard: Separating or pooling equilibrium under stated costs; experimental support.

ST.O.A5.2.standard: The pattern appears in documented decisions and in controlled studies.

ST.O.A5.3.standard: Scored accuracy (Brier) against outcomes, sample size stated [tetlock-c02].

ST.O.A5.4.standard: Argument from the payoff's convexity, supported by tail data where it exists.

ST.O.A5.5.standard: Attribution and effect established from dated records [rid-c07].
